title: Uptime, SSL & Domain Watch
description: Check public HTTP endpoints and compare supplied certificate/domain expiry dates.

assignments.task: Check endpoint reachability and report approaching supplied expiry dates.

fields.label: Public URLs
fields.help: One http:// or https:// endpoint per line. No credentials.

fields.label: Known expiry dates
fields.help: Optional certificate/domain names and ISO dates from your provider. Leave blank if unknown.

fields.label: Alert guidance
fields.help: Describe when an upcoming expiry or unavailable page needs attention.
fields.default: Flag unavailable endpoints and supplied expiry dates within 30 days.

instructions: Use the uptime-watch skill. Fetch each supplied public HTTP endpoint using the bounded web tools and report the observed result. Compare supplied expiry dates with time.now; clearly mark those dates as user-supplied. If expiry metadata is absent, report that it was not checked. Return results to the mission notification router. Do not renew, purchase or modify services.
prerequisites: Supply public HTTP endpoints and any expiry dates you want checked.
approvalPoints: Read-only endpoint checks. Renewals, spending and external changes are denied.
limitations: This compatible mission template uses Researcher; a custom workflow can use the available Monitor.
HTTP checks do not collect TLS certificate or domain registration metadata.
Each occurrence is a budgeted model mission; choose the interval with cost in mind.
